problem:
Find the standard matrix that  represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}2x+3y \\ y\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2\cdot x+3\cdot y \\ 0\cdot x+1\cdot y\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2x+3y \\ y\end{aligned}].
$$

    Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
